scripts.build:packages: bun --filter @netscry/core build && bun --filter @netscry/schemas build && bun --filter @netscry/sdk build
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:packages && tsc --noEmit && bun --filter @netscry/web typecheck
scripts.dev: bun run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others --names web,docs "bun scripts/alchemy-dev.ts dev" "bun --filter @netscry/docs dev"
scripts.dev:web: bun run build:packages && bun scripts/alchemy-dev.ts dev
scripts.check: bun run check:code && bun run check:docs
scripts.check:code: bun run build:packages && ultracite check apps packages scripts alchemy.run.ts oxfmt.config.ts oxlint.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.check:docs: bun --filter @netscry/docs check && bun --filter @netscry/docs doctor && bun --filter @netscry/docs validate
scripts.build: bun run verify:packages && bun --filter @netscry/web build && bun --filter @netscry/docs build
